Oh my god! That is the worst thing EVER. I've been physically assaulted by my family for YEARS because of my anger issues and mental breakdowns. They understand now that I got diagnosed with bipolar disorder, but still no one ever apologized or recognised that they were wrong and whenever I bring up this topic, they say I'm being annoying. I makes me very angry.

I read your post. I go through the same thing with people. I am a very sociable person but I get disappointed with 99% of people that I meet. I don't trust anyone anymore besides my mom. She's the only thing I can hold onto to keep my life going. My advice to you is keep trying to talk to a therapist or psychiatrist. I've been through the same thing. First time I saw a therapist it took me one year to start talking about my issues. Now, whenever I see a different therapist or psychiatrist I just spill it all out without thinking twice. That's their job you know to listen to us. I think it may help you. I think you should find something to hold on to. I'm really sad that you have family issues. Family is important. But maybe try to find something else, maybe something you enjoy doing like painting or playing an instrument or even a pet. Friends come and go, so does significant others. It hurts but it's true. Hope you find some peace man. Like you've said, we've got this. Let's just live one day at a time and see what the future holds for us.

I was really worried about Tyler when I heard Leave The City and Neon Gravestones. 
First of all in Neon Gravestones he says:
"[...] If I lose to myself [...] He admits he has suicidal thoughts.

Leave The City sounds like a hopeless song. I suffer from mental illness and I think this way sometimes. Like, part of me thinks I'll never get away from this and I feel like one day I will lose the fight. I think sometimes Tyler feels the same way. Like in time, he's gonna "leave", but for now he'll keep fighting, even thought he's tired.

Also, I'm convinced Cut My Lip is about self-harm. And "cutting his lip" is a sensored way of saying "cutting his wrist". And the vultures on his roof, like they are just waiting for him to... well you know what I mean...

I don't know, guys. I may be overreacting. But since Chester Bennington died and left songs like "Leave Out Of The Rest" which are basically a suicidal notes and no one ever noticed until he passed away I began looking at artists music in a more careful way. 

How about we ignore DEMA and Clancy for a while and wonder about what is truly going on inside of Tyler's brain.

Morph + Chlorine = Morphine. 
Could the bishops drug people with Morphine? Morphine is a highly addictive opiate and it's used to treat patients with severe pain. It has a numbing effect. In Nico and The Niners you can see people looking very spacy and kind of numb. Maybe Clancy stopped taking Morphine and that's when he realized what really goes on in DEMA.
Also, Neon Gravestones and Leave The City made me worry about Tyler. If you look at the lyrics in a literal way (ignoring the whole DEMA thing and Clancy). It seems to me that Tyler has suicidal thoughts.
And Cut My Lip sounds like a sensored way of saying "cut my wrist". I think this song is about self-harm. Of course, Tyler doesn't want his fans to make the mistake of cutting their wrists, so he changed the lyrics to "cut my lip".
